caption: The drawing features a single cylindrical ceramic jar with a short, wide neck and an open top. The jar is depicted in a grayish-white color, with a glossy, slightly reflective surface. Around the central body of the jar, there are decorative blue painted patterns: these include stylized floral motifs, a bird, leafy branches, and a basket, as well as wavy lines that encircle the vessel. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige tone, with no additional objects or features, and the jar is centrally placed. The artist's signature, "Eduard Buschmar," is faintly visible in small letters near the lower right corner of the image.
title: Stoneware Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
